items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support comfort and the look of low moisture.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides that blends well on deeper skin tones and protects skin that is more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: We have left the facial wax strips out because waxing is best avoided while on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or dermatologist about gentler hair-removal options for your upper lip. Cleanse gently morning and night, moisturize after each wash, and apply the SPF every morning.
